courses.title: 3D Printing Technologies
courses.description: Provides the background and skill set to use 3D printer and laser scanning technologies, and will be done in cooperation with the Maker Space initiative at the SFU Library. Students will learn the basic concepts of 3D printing, computer design tools, and the use of 3D scanners to make replicas of existing objects. Students will complete several 3D printed projects within the course.

courses.title: Intro to Cyber Skills
courses.description: Introduces cybersecurity concepts, principles and practices in responding to the globally evolving cyber threat landscape. In addition to the lecture component, students will work with community clients to improve their cybersecurity resilience and instill technical, managerial, and legal best practices into their organizations.
